title: Word of Gosh
description: Word of Gosh — The Townstons wiki
html:
Word of Gosh
Client type:  1H Axe
Class palette:  Fighter
Quality:  Mythic (rainbow)

Word of Gosh is a named mythic item from the client file items/pal/1HAxePAL.gc (MythicPreBuilt005).

This is the base name. Rolled mythics can also append a suffix from Mythic Suffixes. Those endings change the last part of the name and add the bonus listed on that page. This page does not invent extra roll combinations.

The template sets SoulBound = true. Go forth unto the World and spread the 'Word' of Gosh to thine enemy. Hint: Actions speak louder than words.

Fixed mods on this template (client LabelType = NONE, always on the item):

  • AGI, END
  • Ranged reflect
  • +Divine
  • +Divine, +Slashing
  • Max mana
